items.change: New fixed-choice helper extracts the direct import header of PaperAxioms.lean and/or SupportAxioms.lean, builds their union, then runs each audit from the Lean project directory. Names are validated ASCII Lean modules; subprocess receives argument lists, not shell commands. --dry-run performs no builds.
items.limitation: Helper prints Lean axiom reports; it does not itself compare axioms against a whitelist or assert exact declaration coverage. The manuscript verifier performs those checks for paper-cited declarations. Only the current plain import-header syntax is supported; unfamiliar syntax is not claimed to be a general Lean parser.

items.change: Inventory tracked files plus nonignored untracked source files using Git. Always include every baseline path, so new ignore rules cannot hide missing or altered baseline files. Known artifacts are filtered only from untracked candidates. Tracked added files are never filtered, even beneath ignored/artifact directories. Source-directory inventory derives from selected source-file ancestors.
items.archive_fallback: Without Git executable/metadata, os.walk excludes .git/.lake/__pycache__, paper/build, .DS_Store and listed TeX/Python artifacts. Every baseline file is still explicitly checked. Arbitrary .gitignore rules are not interpreted in archive mode; ignored-file provenance cannot be reconstructed. Empty directories are excluded in both modes.
items.editorial_amendment: verification/upstream-editorial-amendment.json pins only seven existing paper .tex/.bib/.bbl/.pdf files to reviewed Git blob hashes, validates the baseline digest/commit/directory and every before hash, and cannot amend Lean sources. Any nonlisted change or further change/removal of an amended document fails.
